Mr. Pradeep Jain’s respected father suggested the name of the brand as Surbhi means “Fragrance”. And it is rightly said, the best way to eat food is with the sense of smell and sight first and later with taste buds.

featured_reviews.name: DonD Marley
featured_reviews.review_text:
Overview
Surbhi Sweets is an excellent sweet-shop with a wide and appealing selection. It’s especially convenient for commuters picking up snacks before catching trains from Borivali.

What I liked
- Flavor and quality: Everything I tried was very tasty — fresh, well-balanced sweetness and authentic regional flavors.
- Variety: Large range of items including Gujarati snacks and sweet treats plus offerings from South India, so you can sample different regional specialties in one place.
- Convenience for travelers: Ideal for train commuters from Borivali — quick pick-up, portable packaging, and good choices for eating on the go.
- Location: Close to my hotel, which made it easy to visit multiple times. That proximity meant I could try several items across visits.
- Overall experience: Friendly service and pleasant shopping/eating visits; consistently enjoyable.

Practical notes
- Best for: Commuters, travelers, and anyone who wants a wide regional selection of sweets and snacks.
- Ordering/packing: Portions and packaging are commuter-friendly (easy to carry, good for short journeys).
- Repeat visits: Worth returning to — I had a pleasure eating there a few times and kept finding new items I liked.

Recommendation
Highly recommended — a must-try for anyone near Borivali or passing through by train who wants tasty, diverse sweets and snacks.

featured_reviews.review_text:
India is a country known for many religions, languages, cultures & colorful festivals. No wonder, in such a vibrant society, sweets are not simply consumable items. We, Indians, believe in sharing the joy of life & the celebrations of life. And what are celebrations without sweets!

Unique quality, variety, novelty, taste & prompt service: these are some of the salient features of Madhuram sweets. Strict checking is done at every step, in the process of production, to ensure that the desired quality is achieved. By using innovative methods, they keep on producing sweets & namkeen to match with the taste & flavour of different seasons & festivals. Hence, they have an amazing variety of items to satisfy our esteemed customers.

Offering a wide assortment of delicious Indian sweets on the menu at pretty reason able prices, this shop is a local-favourite for buying and gifting sweets. It is touted to offers good quality products made using pure ingredients, and also offers toothsome snacking items, such as namkeen, mathri etc. Recommended - Samosa, Kalakand, Khaman Dhokla and Milk Cake.

featured_reviews.name: Azim Hannure
featured_reviews.review_text:
Vividham Sweet and Dryfruits Shop in Mumbai is a wonderful destination for anyone who enjoys authentic Indian sweets and premium dry fruits. The shop offers a wide range of traditional sweets, snacks, and dry fruits that are perfect for every occasion. Each sweet is freshly prepared, rich in flavor, and beautifully presented. Their dry fruits, including almonds, cashews, and pistachios, are of high quality and make excellent gifts during festivals or celebrations.

The store maintains good hygiene and is neatly organized, making the shopping experience pleasant. The staff is polite, helpful, and knowledgeable about the products, which adds to the overall satisfaction. Prices are reasonable considering the quality offered, and there are many options to choose from — whether you want something for daily treats or festive gifting.

Located conveniently in Mumbai, Vividham is easily accessible and has earned a loyal customer base for its consistent quality. While it can get crowded during peak hours, the freshness and taste make it worth the visit. Overall, Vividham Sweet and Dryfruits Shop is a trusted place for delicious sweets and premium dry fruits that truly capture the essence of Indian tradition and taste.

Heaven for street food lovers, Yummiest chats and very reasonable rates. But do not this is a crowded place and there is no seating and even comfortable standing. But all the dishes you try makes up for it.

This was our second/third visit to this place, "Ragda Pattice" is always in  the order each time. Other than that we tried "Chole Samosa" & "Crushed Sevpuri". "Crushed Sevpuri" was new for us and it tasted really great. Must try. Would recommend all three But if you can't have three, Here's my order from that day 1. Chole Samosa, 2. Crushed Sevpuri 3. Ragda Pattice.

Turned out other two items were more yummier than "Ragda Pattice", So on our next visit we have more options to choose from :) and less options to explore :(.

featured_reviews.name: Pratibha Rajput
featured_reviews.review_text:
A shop calling itself “Shreeram Sweets” should be ashamed of such pathetic standards. An ₹80 kachori was shamelessly wrapped in dirty newspaper — absolutely unhygienic and unacceptable in today’s time.
When I politely asked for proper packing, instead of apologizing, the staff n owner also rudely demanded extra packing charges, with complete arrogance and zero customer etiquette.
So customers are expected to pay full price but get newspaper trash instead of hygienic food packing, and then be treated badly for questioning it?
No respect, no hygiene, no basic manners.
This place clearly doesn’t care about food safety, cleanliness, or customer dignity.
Strongly NOT recommended. Save your money and self-respect.

featured_reviews.name: Rachita Pai
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely disgusting and unacceptable. I was served vada pav with bread that had visible fungus and mold growing on it. This isn’t a small mistake, it’s a serious health hazard. The lack of basic hygiene and quality control is shocking. God knows how long the food had been sitting there. Serving something like this to customers is beyond careless and downright irresponsible. Will never return and would strongly advise others to stay away.
